english_text: O He remembering whom brings honour to those who remember!

transliteration: wa yā man shukruhu fawzun li-lshākirīn
english_text: O He thanking whom brings triumph to those who give thanks!

transliteration: wa yā man ṭāʿatuhu najātun lil-muṭīʿīn
english_text: O He obeying whom brings deliverance to those who obey!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاشْغَلْ قُلُوبَنَا بِذِكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ ذِكْر، وَأَلْسِنَتَنَا بِشُكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ شُكْر وَجَوَارِحَنَا بِطَاعَتِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ طَاعَة.
transliteration: ṣallī ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-ashghal qulubana bi-dhikrika ʿan kulli dhikr wa'al-sinatana bi-shukrika 'an kulli shukr wa jawāriḥanā biṭāʿatika ʿan kulli ṭāʿah
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household, and divert our hearts through remembering Thee from every act of remembrance, our tongues through thanking Thee from every act of thanksgiving, our limbs through obeying Thee from every act of obedience!

arabic_text: فَإنْ قَدَّرْتَ لَنَا فَرَاغاً مِنْ شُغُل فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغَ سَلاَمَة لا تُدْرِكُنَا فِيهِ تَبِعَةٌ وَلاَ تَلْحَقُنَا فِيهِ سَاَمَةٌ
transliteration: fa-in qaddarta lana faraghan min shughulin faj'alhu faragha salamah lā tudrikunā fīhi tabiʿatun walā talḥaqunā fīhi sāmatun
english_text: If Thou hast ordained for us idleness from these occupations, make it an idleness of safety, within which no ill consequence visits us or weariness overtakes us!

arabic_text: حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ عَنَّا كُتَّابُ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِصَحِيفَة خَالِيَة مِنْ ذِكْرِ سَيِّئاتِنَا َو يَتَوَلّى كُتَّابُ الْحَسَنَاتِ عَنَّا مَسْرُورِينَ بِمَا كَتَبُوا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا .
transliteration: ḥattá yanṣarifa ʿannā kuttabu al-sayyiʾāti bi-ṣaḥīfah khāliyah min dhikri sayyi wa yatawallā kuttabu al-ḥasanāti `annā masroorīna bi mā katabū min hasanātinā
english_text: Then the writers of evil deeds may depart from us with a page empty of the mention of our evil deeds, and the writers of good deeds may turn away from us happy with the good deeds of ours which they have written.

arabic_text: وَإذَا انْقَضَتْ أَيَّامُ حَيَاتِنَـا وَتَصَرَّمَتْ مُـدَدُ أَعْمَارِنَـا، وَاسْتَحْضَرَتْنَا دَعْوَتُكَ الَّتِي لاَ بُدَّ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ إجَابَتِهَا ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْ خِتَامَ مَا تُحْصِي عَلَيْنَا كَتَبَةُ أَعْمَالِنَا
transliteration: wa-idhā inqaḍat ayyāmu ḥayātinā wa taṣarramat mudadu aʿmārinā wa-istahđaratnā daʿwatuka allatī lā budda minhā wa-min ijābatiha faṣalli ʿala muḥammad wa ālih wa-jʿal khitām ma tuḥṣi ʿalaynā kutabat aʿmālinā
english_text: And when the days of our life have passed by, the terms of our lifetimes have elapsed, and Thy call, which must come and be answered, summons us forth, then bless Muhammad and his Household and make the outcome of what the writers of our works count against us

arabic_text: تَوْبَةً مَقْبُولَةً لا تُوقِفُنَا بَعْدَهَا عَلَى ذَنْب اجْتَرَحْنَاهُ، وَلاَ مَعْصِيَة اقْتَرَفْنَاهَا،
transliteration: tawbatan maqbūlatan lā tuqifunā baʿdahā ʿalā dhamb ijtarahnāhu walā maʿṣiyatan iqtarafnāhā
english_text: an accepted repentance, which afterwards gave us no rest in a sin that we committed or an act of disobedience that we performed!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْراً سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الأشْهَادِ يَوْمَ تَبْلُو أَخْبَارَ عِبَادِكَ
transliteration: walā takshef ʿannā sitran satartahu ʿalā ruʾūsi al-ashhād yawma tablū akhbāra ʿibādika
english_text: Remove not from us any covering with which Thou hast covered over the heads of the witnesses on the day when the records of Thy servants are tried!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ، وَمُسْتَجيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ .
transliteration: 'innaka raḥīmun biman daʿāka, wa mustajībun liman nādāka
english_text: Verily Thou art compassionate to him who supplicates Thee, the responder to him who calls upon Thee!
